title: Another theme park
content: I'm getting lots of theme park dreams lately. Is it because I've been reading up on amusement park disasters? Anyway, last night's dream involved this theme park. This one was themed as a hilly village, and I remember there were a lot of curvy roads going through the forest surrounding it, and a center area with a roundabout and a giant boulder in the middle. Several small shack-type buildings surrounded the boulder roundabout and contained things like gift shops. I picked a road leading away from the roundabout (on foot) and went down a short hill to a larger building with brick walls and large glass windows, it looked like a school building. It was an auditorium and convention center. Inside, there was also a small convenience store. In the speaking area, there were a bunch of people gathered around to watch someone give a lecture on "The Wheel of Time". I didn't stick around to find out what that meant, but I wish I had in retrospect. I strolled around the convenience store for a bit, searching for a snack. I noticed the TV in the corner was playing a news station, which was covering a story about how the local police were searching for an arsonist but didn't have any information yet. I got my snack, which was this neat thing I have never seen IRL. It was like a ball of funnel cake with the powdered sugar dusting on top, but it was filled like a jelly doughnut with strawberry jelly and some kind of cream. It was SO GOOD. There was a banana pudding filled one too but I didn't get it. As soon as I got out of the building, I noticed all the people had disappeared and it was eerily quiet outside. Still daytime. Just no one around, and all the background noise was missing, I mean all of it, like not just the sounds of cars and people talking but all the wind and the birds too. I took this as a sign that I had to get out of there like, yesterday. So I booked it as far as my legs would take me, on some random road leading hopefully out of the park. After running for what seemed like hours I made it to an apartment complex, a run down one that you could just tell was full of roaches. It was still strangely silent, and I saw a shadow which gave me a bad feeling, so I ducked inside one of the apartment buildings and found myself in a hallway, with nothing in it. The walls were bare concrete and there were no doors or windows, aside from a dark nook to one side. I went in there and found there was only one light bulb hanging from the ceiling, I turned it on and the room was also empty and made of bare concrete, except for a washer and dryer. Finally I heard noise again, the hum of the light and the banging sounds coming from the washer and dryer...those weren't ordinary sounds, nothing was being washed. I opened the top lid of the washer and there was a little boy stuffed in there somehow. Alive and conscious, but not in good condition. I managed to free him, slowly and carefully. He just said "you have to get me out of here...they want to kill me..." I didn't even ask who or why, just ran. And I ran with this kid in my arms as fast and as far as I could go. I couldn't run anymore and just collapsed on some grass without looking where I had ended up. After taking some breaths I realized I was back at the theme park, and it was full of people again. I took the boy to the welcome center and they explained to me that he had gone missing from this very park a few days ago. They were going to give me a reward while they tended to the child, but suddenly a group of people busted open the door and one pointed at me and yelled, "y...y...YOU--!" I didn't know who they were, but they didn't have any good intentions towards me, so I ran once more. This time I took a different road, this one leading into a deep forest area. I didn't make it far before the dream ended.
